13 Application Substation DC distribution, control and protection circuits 3. Scope of Supply Supply of 09 Nos. 2-Pole, 25 A DC MCBs, complete with all necessary accessories, conforming to the above technical specifications and suitable for installation in the existing DC distribution system of substations. 4. Important Technical Conditions 1. The MCB shall be specifically designed, rated and tested for DC operation at the applicable system vol tage. AC-only MCBs shall not be acceptable. 2. The manufacturer shall clearly indicate the rated DC voltage, DC breaking capacity, polarity requirem ents and permissible pole connection (series or parallel, if applicable) in the product datasheet. 3. The selected breaking capacity and tripping characteristic shall be compatible with the prospective D C fault level and the protection coordination of the existing DC system. .
